gloss: roasting machine; roaster (for coffee or tea)

definitions.explanation: A machine used to roast raw materials, most commonly coffee beans, applying controlled heat to develop flavor and aroma.

examples.japanese: {店内|てんない}に{焙煎機|ばいせんき}がある。
examples.english: There is a roasting machine inside the shop.

examples.japanese: {自家|じか}{焙煎|ばいせん}の{店|みせ}では{大|おお}きな{焙煎機|ばいせんき}でコーヒー{豆|まめ}を{焼|や}いている。
examples.english: At a self-roasting shop, they roast coffee beans in a large roasting machine.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{家庭用|かていよう}の{小型|こがた}{焙煎機|ばいせんき}も{手|て}に{入|はい}るようになった。
examples.english: Recently, small home-use roasting machines have become available.

notes:
Composed of {焙煎|ばいせん} (roasting) and {機|き} (machine). Most commonly associated with coffee culture, where {自家焙煎|じかばいせん} (in-house roasting) cafés have become popular in Japan. Can also refer to machines for roasting tea leaves ({茶|ちゃ}), barley ({麦|むぎ}), or other foods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コーヒー{焙煎機|ばいせんき} — coffee roasting machine
- {家庭用|かていよう}{焙煎機|ばいせんき} — home roasting machine
- {小型|こがた}{焙煎機|ばいせんき} — small roaster
- {焙煎機|ばいせんき}で{焼|や}く — to roast in a roasting machine

RELATED TERMS:
- {焙煎|ばいせん} — roasting (the process)
- {自家焙煎|じかばいせん} — in-house roasting; self-roasting
- ロースター — roaster (loanword)
